_comment: Coverage ratchet baselines (#185), consumed by scripts/coverage_gate.py.
Measured on main by the coverage CI job (MODE=cov, gcc-14, Linux arm64,
unit + int with the reference models; runs 37868242302, 37890700255,
37928982436 on 2026-10-09) and rounded DOWN to whole percent from the
lowest of the three. Raising after an improvement is routine; lowering
requires a justified, reviewed edit. null = not yet measured, which the
gate treats as a failure that prints the measured value.
floors are hard minimums outside the ratchet. src/io is the malformed-GGUF
parser surface: test_io_malformed_unit drives both readers hermetically,
and the floor sits just under what it reaches (86.5 %) - raise it with the
coverage, do not let it drift down.
src/archs/vision_siglip is mostly unexercised by the unit + int suites
(12 %); the baseline only stops it from falling further.
